|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “For remainder of turn, cancel game text of one character that is at the same system as Vader.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I'm On The Leader (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Cancel the game text of a character at same system as Vader for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' “For remainder of turn, cancel” → “Cancel the”; “one” → “a”; removed “that is”; removed “the”; “Vader.” → “Vader for remainder of turn.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 37. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[I'm On The Leader]].
* Later text: [[I'm On The Leader (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
